findings.description: The KMS customer-managed key used to encrypt the audit bucket does not enable automatic key rotation (enable_key_rotation is absent, defaulting to false). Without annual rotation, a compromised or leaked key material remains usable indefinitely, increasing the blast radius for all data encrypted under this key.

findings.issue_category: No key usage constraints / missing key policy
findings.description: The key defines no key policy. Because aws_kms_key does not fall back to a default restrictive policy in the way some resources do, the resulting policy grants the account root principal full kms:* administrative control over this audit key. Any principal that can assume the account root (or is delegated admin rights) can disable, schedule deletion of, or re-grant access to the encryption key protecting audit logs.
